description: ORD document describing the Acme Corp retail platform APIs, events, and entity types.

vendors.title: Acme Corp
vendors.shortDescription: Acme Corporation — operator of the retail demo platform

packages.title: Core Package
packages.shortDescription: Core APIs and events for the Acme retail platform
packages.description: Bundles the primary API and event resources of the Acme retail platform, covering catalogue management, order processing, and customer lifecycle events.

packages.title: Analytics Package
packages.description: Provides analytical API resources for reporting, KPI dashboards, and data consumption use cases across the retail platform.

consumptionBundles.title: Public API Bundle
consumptionBundles.shortDescription: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials protected access to all public APIs
consumptionBundles.description: Default consumption bundle granting access to all publicly visible API resources via the OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow.

consumptionBundles.title: Internal Service Bundle
consumptionBundles.shortDescription: Internal access bundle for trusted back-end services
consumptionBundles.description: Consumption bundle for internal microservices and trusted partners that require access to internal-visibility resources.

apiResources.title: Product Catalogue API
apiResources.shortDescription: REST API for managing the product catalogue
apiResources.description: Provides full CRUD operations for catalogue items, including product variants, pricing tiers, stock levels, and category assignments.

apiResources.title: Order Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: OData V4 API for order lifecycle management
apiResources.description: Covers the full order lifecycle: create, update, confirm, ship, and cancel operations for orders and their line items.

apiResources.title: Reporting & Analytics API
apiResources.shortDescription: GraphQL API for sales and inventory analytics
apiResources.description: Exposes analytical queries over sales figures, inventory levels, customer segments, and order KPIs for internal reporting dashboards.

eventResources.title: Catalogue Change Events
eventResources.description: Publishes domain events whenever catalogue items are created, updated, deactivated, or deleted. Follows the CloudEvents 1.0 specification.

eventResources.title: Order Lifecycle Events
eventResources.description: Publishes events for order placement, confirmation, dispatch, delivery, and cancellation.

entityTypes.title: Catalogue Item
entityTypes.shortDescription: A sellable item in the product catalogue
entityTypes.description: Root aggregate entity representing a product offered for sale, including its variants, pricing, and stock information.

entityTypes.title: Order
entityTypes.description: Root aggregate representing a customer order, comprising an order header and one or more order lines.

entityTypes.title: Customer
entityTypes.description: Root aggregate for a customer account, including contact details, address book, and order history references.
